Topic 2.3: Capacity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Capacity. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-093.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 93]]

From your pupil's book (page 93)

Capacity Week 9 Lesson 2 Measuring Capacity in Litres

Capacity is measured in litres. Liquids such as water, milk and petrol can be used to measure the capacity of different containers.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Capacity means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Capacity.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Capacity
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES

4. Revise with the quiz now.
